SECTION C: Short Answer Type Questions (3 Marks Each)

Q28. How does democracy produce an accountable, responsive and legitimate 
government?

Answer / Solution:
How does democracy produce an accountable, responsive and legitimate 
government? 
Accountable: Citizens choose leaders and can hold them answerable. 
Responsive: Government responds to public needs and demands. 
Legitimate: It is elected by people through free and fair elections; it is people’s own 
government.
